Point and editorial state locators do not establish whole-feature physical containment.
Scientific claims and public release remain under review.

geometries.method: Editorial subpolar North Pacific point north of the North Pacific Current and within the glossary-described Aleutian Current region; not a surveyed core or endpoint.
geometries.positional_uncertainty: not quantified; no observed current core or path

length_assessments.illustration_limit: Drawn map-arrow span, not a physical current length or lower bound
length_assessments.scope: The meteorological glossary identifies this as the southern eastward limb of the North Pacific subpolar gyre, also called the Subarctic Current. Its mixing with the North Pacific Current and variable frontal boundary leave no source-defined whole-current length for this ledger.
